metrics.definition: Recall@K is the fraction of answerable cases with any expected chunk in top K; MRR uses the first expected chunk. Evidence coverage is expected gold chunks that were actually cited divided by expected chunks. Citation correctness checks that citations map to returned source IDs (and abstentions contain no citations). Page accuracy uses only cases with a gold page. Synthetic smoke evaluation only; no confidence intervals or production claims.
